::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 17th [1869?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library: Berg Collection
:::

Dear [Miss Ingelow](people/person_741.qmd)
I enclose a note from a friend of mine, a young clergyman’s wife, who is as you see trying to raise the money for an Organ for her husband’s Church in the close neighbourhood of the White Horse of Berkshire

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
